# geoaeo

> Free, open-source CLI, MCP server, and library that audits any site 0-100 for SEO, GEO, and AEO and generates llms.txt, sitemaps, JSON-LD, WebMCP, and Markdown mirrors.

## What it is

geoaeo makes any app discoverable, quotable, and usable by AI answer engines and search — SEO, GEO, and AEO in one tool. It audits a live URL or local site directory, scores it 0-100 across 24 weighted checks (answerability, structured data, llms.txt, crawlability, freshness, E-E-A-T), and generates the files answer engines read. It ships a library, a CLI, and an MCP server at one version.

## Docs

- [Install](https://usegeoaeo.com/docs/install): `npm install geoaeo`, `npx geoaeo init`, `geoaeo.config.ts`
- [CLI reference](https://usegeoaeo.com/docs/cli): `audit <url|dir>`, `init`, `gen <artifact>`, `humanize`, `mcp`
- [MCP server](https://usegeoaeo.com/docs/mcp): `npx geoaeo-mcp` over stdio, tools `audit`, `gen`, `humanize`
- [Harnesses](https://usegeoaeo.com/docs): Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Continue setup
- [GEO/AEO checklist](https://usegeoaeo.com/checklist): 24 checks with fixes
- [Examples](https://usegeoaeo.com/examples): static-html 80, nextjs-app 48, astro-site 46
- [Docs index](https://usegeoaeo.com/docs)

## API

geoaeo is an npm library, not a hosted API:

- Library: `import { auditTarget, generateLlms, humanizeText } from 'geoaeo'`
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/geoaeo
- GitHub: https://github.com/pooriaarab/usegeoaeo
- MCP: `npx geoaeo-mcp` (bin `geoaeo-mcp`, also `npx geoaeo mcp`) over stdio

## Pricing

Free and open-source under the MIT license. `npm i geoaeo`. Hosted tools at https://usegeoaeo.com/tools are free. No paid tier.

## Tools

- [Site audit](https://usegeoaeo.com/tools): Score any URL 0-100 for SEO, GEO, and AEO.
- [llms.txt generator](https://usegeoaeo.com/tools): Generate an llms.txt for your site.
- [JSON-LD generator](https://usegeoaeo.com/tools): Generate schema.org structured data.

## Agents

- [agents.md](https://usegeoaeo.com/agents.md): guide for AI agents that discover, evaluate, or use geoaeo
- [WebMCP](https://usegeoaeo.com/webmcp.json): machine-readable tools manifest
- [agent-card](https://usegeoaeo.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A-style agent card

## Common questions

Q: What are GEO and AEO?
A: Generative Engine Optimization and Answer Engine Optimization: making a site easy for AI systems to find, quote, and cite.

Q: Is geoaeo free?
A: Yes. Free and open source under the MIT license. Install it with `npm install geoaeo`.

Q: Does it work with my framework?
A: Yes. `npx geoaeo init` detects Next.js, Astro, SvelteKit, Nuxt, and Remix and writes App Router routes or static files. Any other site gets static artifacts.

Q: What does audit check?
A: 24 weighted checks for answerability, structured data, llms.txt, crawlability, freshness, and E-E-A-T. Run `npx geoaeo audit <url|dir>` for the score and gap list.
